# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x     | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it responsibly:

1. **Do NOT** open a public GitHub issue
2. Email **security@westbridge.gy** with:
   - Description of the vulnerability
   - Steps to reproduce
   - Potential impact
3. You will receive a response within 48 hours
4. Once confirmed, we will work on a fix and coordinate disclosure

## Scope

This policy covers the Swift platform operated by Westbridge Inc. Please report
only issues you can demonstrate against your own account or test data — do not
access, modify, or exfiltrate other users' data. We do not run a paid bug-bounty
program; we acknowledge good-faith reports and will not pursue action against
researchers who follow this policy.
